newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on buying of blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on buying of blue chips.

text.p: Buying of blue chip shares helped Dhaka stocks make marginal gains at the close on Thursday for a fourth straight session, brokers said.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) ended 3.82 points or 0.20 percent up at 1,879.58 on a turnover of 54.9 million taka. Of 92 traded issues, 48 rose, 40 lost and four remained unchanged. "Selling of high priced shares continued, but blue chips helped the index sustain the pressure and move up," said a broker. Leasing company IDLC gained 83 taka to 4,107, Singer Bangladesh rose 280 to 12,183 and Standard Ceramic was up 20 to 884. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
